business_summary: Henan Xinning Modern Logistics Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides logistics and supply chain management services in China. It offers warehousing and value-added warehousing, freight forwarding, customs declaration, inspection and quarantine agency, transportation, and vehicle satellite positioning services, as well as location and software development services. The company was formerly known as Jiangsu Xinning Modern Logistics Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Henan Xinning Modern Logistics Co.,Ltd. in July 2022. Henan Xinning Modern Logistics Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is based in Zhengzhou, China.

Henan Xinning Modern Logistics Co.,Ltd. 1997년에 설립되었으며 중국 정저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
